title: Transfer - Coating Load Estimate
goal: Inspect one noisy binary STL whose triangle attributes encode coating recipe IDs, isolate the production part, compute its exterior surface area, and estimate coating mass or cost from a process table.
skillBenefitRationale: This preserves the skill's binary STL parsing, component isolation, and attribute decoding benefits, but transfers the engineering target from volume-based mass to surface-area-based finishing analysis.
